results.summary: Review cycle 1 FAILED and the fixer reported it could not fix the findings: Applied the requested Phase 1 fixes and focused authorization tests/Pint pass. Validation still fails at `composer types:check` on restored non-Phase-1 files (`OrganizationController` return types and `config/horizon.php` env typing).. Nothing committed; changes left unstaged.
findings: high/spec-deviation docs/ideation/2026-09-02-domain-colocated-authorization/spec-phase-1.md:1 — Requested Phase 1 spec file is absent from the working tree, while the new context map references it as the implementation contract → Restore/add the Phase 1 spec at this path so the diff can be reviewed against the authoritative contract

high/spec-deviation app/Models/User.php:33 — Phase 1 scope is exceeded: the context map says exactly ten new files and no modified/deleted files, but the diff includes Phase 2 membership/model/schema/factory/test work plus unrelated controller/Horizon edits → Revert or split every non-Phase-1 change out of this working tree

medium/testing tests/Feature/Authorization/AuthorizationSyncCommandTest.php:81 — Spec edge cases for invalid authorization.guard/catalogs and invalid or empty enum values are implemented in the command but not exercised by tests → Add command feature tests for those validation-failure paths

low/pattern-mismatch app/Console/Commands/SyncAuthorization.php:16 — Pattern notes call for the generated Laravel command skeleton using protected $signature/$description, but this command uses console attributes instead → Switch to the specified skeleton style or update the spec/pattern guidance to explicitly allow attributes

results.title: Membership Authorization Principal
results.summary: Review cycle 2 FAILED and the fixer reported it could not fix the findings: Reverted the non-Phase-2 Horizon/controller edits and replaced parent-delete membership iteration with eachById() plus chunk-size regression tests. Pint and the focused membership tests pass, but composer types:check fails on the reverted non-Phase-2 Horizon/controller issues.. Nothing committed; changes left unstaged.
findings: high/spec-deviation config/horizon.php:70 — Persists from cycle 1: working tree still includes non-Phase-2 edits (`config/horizon.php` prefix closure and `app/Http/Controllers/OrganizationController.php` void return types) that are not listed in Phase 2 File Changes → Revert or split these unrelated changes before committing this phase

high/logic app/Models/Organization.php:21 — Parent-delete cleanup deletes memberships via `each()`, and `User.php` repeats the same pattern; Laravel `each()` uses offset chunking, so deleting rows during iteration can skip memberships after the first chunk and leave their role pivots orphaned by FK cascade → Use `eachById()`/`lazyById()` or explicit pivot cleanup in both parent hooks and add a regression test with enough memberships to exercise chunking
